data.name: Hosian
data.gender_notes: Hosian is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Hosian means 'save, deliver' which can be traced back to the Hebrew prophet Hosea. This name is a call to God for salvation and deliverance from difficulties. It is also a name given to a child born after a difficult ordeal or trial. The name Hosian carries the meaning “Save, Deliver” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Hosian usually hope their child will grow to embody save, deliver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes trust and reliance on God for salvation and deliverance.
data.etymology: Hosian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Save, Deliver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hosian total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name can serve as a reminder of the resilience and faith of those who have gone before us in their unwavering trust in God’s providence.
data.spiritual_significance: Hosian is a name imbued with hope and trust in God's power to save and deliver. It is a reminder of the spiritual journey of salvation and redemption, and the belief that no matter the hardships or trials we face, God is always present and willing to help us through. The name Hosian is a powerful meditation on the power of God's love to overcome any obstacle and bring us to a place of peace and joy.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hosian, derived from the Hebrew word "Hosanna," means "save us now" or "help us now." In Christian tradition, it is a cry of praise and supplication, expressing both the joy of deliverance and the urgent need for God's intervention.
